stories.title: The Vision of the Degrees of Glory
stories.blurb: Translating John 5 in the Johnson farmhouse, Joseph and Sidney see the Son of God — 'this is the testimony, last of all' — and three kingdoms answer the old riddle of heaven and hell.

stories.title: Easter at Kirtland: The Lord Accepts His House
stories.blurb: A week after dedication, behind lowered veils: the Savior stands on the breastwork of the pulpit, then Moses, Elias, and Elijah each deliver their keys — Malachi's promise kept.

stories.title: Alvin in the Celestial Kingdom
stories.blurb: In the unfinished temple Joseph sees his unbaptized brother among the heirs of glory — and learns that God judges 'according to the desire of their hearts.'

stories.title: The Vision of the Redemption of the Dead
stories.blurb: An aged prophet, grieving a son and watching a pandemic, ponders 1 Peter — and sees the Savior commission the righteous dead to carry the gospel through the spirit world.

stories.title: Liberty Jail: A Temple-Prison
stories.blurb: Four months in a freezing dungeon wring out the Restoration's deepest pastoral letter: 'Peace be unto thy soul' — and power in the priesthood 'only by persuasion... and love unfeigned.'

stories.title: The Martyrdom of Joseph and Hyrum
stories.blurb: 'A lamb to the slaughter' — the jailhouse hymn, the mob on the stairs, and John Taylor's tribute: Joseph 'has done more, save Jesus only, for the salvation of men in this world.'

stories.title: The Camp of Israel Goes West
stories.blurb: Driven from Nauvoo, the Saints are organized like ancient Israel — companies, covenants, and a commandment to sing: 'If thou art merry, praise the Lord with singing, with music, with dancing.'

stories.title: The Law of the Church
stories.blurb: The revelation the elders gathered to Ohio to receive: teach from the scriptures, keep the commandments, and consecrate property so 'every man may receive according as he stands in need.'

stories.title: A Principle with Promise
stories.blurb: Emma's complaint about tobacco-stained floors becomes a revelation for 'the weakest of all saints': wholesome food, no strong drink, and the promise to 'run and not be weary.'

stories.title: Angels with Keys: The Priesthood Restored
stories.blurb: John the Baptist confers the Priesthood of Aaron beside the Susquehanna; Peter, James, and John follow with the keys of the apostleship — living authority from resurrected hands.

stories.title: The Lesson of the 116 Pages
stories.blurb: Joseph yields to Martin's pleading, loses the manuscript and the gift — then learns that God, foreseeing all from the beginning, had prepared the small plates 'for a wise purpose.'

stories.title: Emma: An Elect Lady
stories.blurb: Scribe, expounder, comforter, and hymn-gatherer — the Lord calls Emma Smith to her lifework and closes with a word to everyone: 'this is my voice unto all.'
